docs.author: Dr. Helen Marsh
sentences: Patient is a 63-year-old man with low back pain for about two months.
No fever, weight loss, saddle numbness or cancer history.
Symptoms persist after more than two months of physical therapy and daily naproxen.
Decreased sensation to light touch over the right L5 dermatome.
Reports numbness and tingling along the outer right calf.
Sleeps about six hours a night.
Plan: MRI of the lumbar spine without contrast.

payer_letter: Bluepeak Insurance has reviewed claim A-1054 for MRI of the lumbar spine. Coverage requires documentation of at least six weeks of conservative treatment together with radicular findings or an objective neurological deficit, or a red flag condition. The records submitted do not document at least six weeks of conservative treatment before imaging. You may request reconsideration within 90 days of this notice.
